body: Keeping a home clean on a recurring basis is one of those things that's easy to fall behind on — work, kids, and life in general tend to win out over scrubbing baseboards. EZClean Pros handles the recurring housekeeping so it's just off your plate: kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living areas, covered top to bottom every single visit.

We work on whatever cadence fits your household — weekly, biweekly, monthly, or a one-time deep pass before guests arrive. Every visit follows the same standard: counters cleared and wiped, floors vacuumed and mopped, bathrooms disinfected, dusting from ceiling fans down to baseboards, and beds made if requested. Nothing rushed, nothing skipped because it's "not on the list this week."

This is a local team, not a franchise call center routing your request to whoever's available three counties over. The same standards and the same accountability apply whether you're in a downtown condo or a house up in Carlsbad.

If it's been a while since the last deep reset — behind appliances, baseboards, window tracks — a one-time deep cleaning pairs well with a recurring plan and gets everything caught up before regular visits take over.

services.h1: Deep Cleaning & Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning in San Diego
services.metaTitle: Deep Cleaning & Move-In/Out San Diego | EZClean Pros
services.metaDescription: The heavier pass: baseboards, inside appliances, fixtures, every corner a standard clean skips. Built for move-in, move-out, and seasonal resets. Call (858) 370-5205.
services.shortDesc: The heavier pass: baseboards, inside appliances, fixtures, and every corner a standard visit doesn't reach. Built for move-in, move-out, and seasonal resets.
body: A standard cleaning visit is built for upkeep. A deep clean is built for the corners that upkeep never touches — baseboards, inside the oven and fridge, light fixtures, window tracks, behind and under furniture. It's the pass you want before new tenants move in, before you hand back the keys on a move-out, or once or twice a year to reset a home that's been coasting on quick cleans.

For move-out cleans specifically, we work to the standard most property managers and landlords expect for a security deposit walkthrough: appliances cleaned inside and out, cabinets wiped down empty, bathrooms fully disinfected, and floors detailed edge to edge. For move-in, the same standard applies before your furniture shows up, so you're not unpacking boxes into someone else's dust.
Seasonal resets work well for households that keep up with regular cleaning but want a periodic deeper pass — think spring cleaning, without you having to actually do it.

For an ongoing plan instead of a one-time reset, recurring residential cleaning picks up right where a deep clean leaves off. And if this is ahead of a sale or new tenant rather than your own move, our real estate turnover cleaning is built specifically for that handoff.

Available throughout San Diego, La Jolla, Pacific Beach, Chula Vista, Coronado, National City, Point Loma, Mission Valley, Clairemont, Carlsbad, and Encinitas. Timed around your moving date or your schedule, not ours.
